crossrefs.text: Every woman shall ask her neighbor and any woman staying in her house for silver and gold jewelry and clothing, and you will put them on your sons and daughters. So you will plunder the Egyptians.”
But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions.
And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that when you leave, you will not go away empty-handed.
And the LORD gave the people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that they granted their request. In this way they plundered the Egyptians.
If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.
I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
Thus God has taken away your fatherʼs livestock and given them to me.
the Lordwas with him and extended kindness to him, granting him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.
The whole army returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one dared to utter a word against the Israelites.
But on that day I will give special treatment to the land of Goshen, where My people live; no swarms of flies will be found there. In this way you will know that I, the LORD, am in the land.
No one could see anyone else, and for three days no one left his place. Yet all the Israelites had light in their dwellings.
So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
But the LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt, so that no animal belonging to the Israelites will die.’”

Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on his throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, as well as all the firstborn among the livestock.
So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.

The LORD instructed Moses, “When you go back to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders that I have put within your power. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.
